title: Day 3 — AI Se Images Banانا: Midjourney & Ideogram Basics
preamble: AI image generation tools جيسا تہي Midjourney اور Ideogram آپ کي textual description سان realistiq, artistic يا unique images بنانے کي مدد کري ثا. بس ايک proper prompt likھنا آهي، اور AI اهو visualize کري ثو. اهي tools design, marketing, social media اور freelancing لاءِ بht usefulness رهي ثا.

sections.label: Concept
sections.content: AI image generation tools جيسا تہي Midjourney اور Ideogram textual prompts سان realistiq, artistic يا unique images بنانے کي مدد کري ثا. بس ايک proper prompt likھنا آهي، اور AI اهو visualize کري ثو. اهي tools design, marketing, social media اور freelancing لاءِ بht usefulness رهي ثا.

sections.label: Example
sections.content:
Midjourney استعمال کري image بنانے لاءِ اهزّي طريقه اپناني چاہجي:
1. Midjourney Discord server join کريو (midjourney.com)
2. Command `/imagine prompt: a cyberpunk city at night, neon lights, futuristic, highly detailed` likھو
3. AI 4 images generate کري ثو، پهر آپ "Upscale" يا "Variation" جو آپشن استعمال کري سگھو.

sections.label: Practice
sections.content:
اپنے Discord server پر Midjourney join کريو، اور اهي prompt try کريو:
`/imagine prompt: a cute corgi dog wearing a chef hat, cooking in a kitchen, cartoon style`

sections.label: Mini Project
sections.content:
AI سان 3 images جو series بنائيو:
1. "A futuristic office in 2050"
2. "A cozy library with floating books"
3. "A dragon flying over a medieval castle"
سب کي save کريو اور ايک folder پر رکيو.
